base_commit: 27ce57d0ed435f4f9f498b7385093a485243054a plus the uncommitted work of 1179 and 1181

environment.os: Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS, Linux 7.0.0-43-generic x86_64; a Linux machine, not WSL
environment.audio: PipeWire with pipewire-pulse; pacat is not installed, so Sigma sends through pw-play (the first of pacat, pw-play, aplay that exists). Not direct ALSA.

verify_apple2_audio.scope: Independent per-cycle oracle and exhaustive bus checks for the Apple II speaker and Mockingboard model; no audio.

verify_apple2_audio_stream.scope: Owned stereo callback fixtures for the Apple II model: nonzero model output stays in memory, no native audio.

timing_authorization: The user answered that other applications were stopped and timing could start (2026-11-22), immediately before the run.

timing.scope:
Apple II audio workloads. The default only verifies them; --measure needs the user's approval of the timing first.

Six workloads of 32768 stereo frames each. Every run, timed or not, compares the whole
PCM and the final state with the per-cycle oracle of verify-apple2-audio.py. With
--measure each workload runs in seven fresh processes, in rotated order, and the wall
time of the synthesis alone (not the set-up, the file write or the comparison) is kept.
